stories.title: An AI project is creating videos to go with Supreme Court justices' real words
stories.summary: The reading of Supreme Court opinions can only be seen by those inside the court. An AI project is trying to change that.

stories.title: Bangladesh holds its first election since ousting its former leader
stories.summary: Bangladeshis go to the polls for the first time since they overthrew their former autocratic leader. Will voters trust the results?

stories.title: These monks' simple walk for peace captivated millions. It ends this week
stories.summary: A group of Buddhist monks walked from Fort Worth, Texas, to Washington, D.C., in the name of peace. Their journey concludes on Wednesday.

stories.title: Bondi and House Democrats clash over Epstein files at DOJ oversight hearing
stories.summary: Attorney General Pam Bondi testified on Capitol Hill Wednesday before House lawmakers in a frequently combative hearing.

stories.title: Norwegian Johannes Klaebo has a shot at winning all 6 events in cross-country skiing
stories.summary: A Norwegian cross-country skier is on track to become the winningest winter Olympian ever. Johannes Klaebo is a talent the likes of which the world has never seen.

stories.title: For many doctors and patients in Minneapolis, medical care has moved underground
stories.summary: The Trump administration's immigration enforcement operation in Minneapolis has pushed many immigrant communities away from hospitals and doctors. Some have responded with underground clinics.
